_comment: KNOWN RED and KNOWN FLAKY browser specs (TC-2120). The Web browser tests job fails only on a failure that is NOT listed here. knownReds: a listed test that fails is printed as a known red; when it passes the job prints 'known red now passes: delete it from the list'. knownFlaky: a listed test that fails on every attempt is reported as a flake and does not fail the job; nothing is printed when it passes. Entry format: { project, file, title (as in the report), line (informational), reason }. Add an entry only with a diagnosis, not as a skip, and delete it when the spec is fixed.

knownFlaky.title: a wrong code shows one plain line with a single shake, clears the boxes and lets you try again
knownFlaky.reason: Timing race in the spec: line 267 reads window.__shakes once, right after the error line is visible, and the animationstart event can fire a frame later (expect(...).toBe(1) is not polled). It failed the first attempt in 1 of 3 local runs and in most GitHub runs, and every attempt in one. A spec fix (expect.poll) needs a test-ruling; not applied.
